question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

Please _________ my apology for this mistake.
solution:
The correct answer is **option 3) 'accept'**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__** 'Accept' is the perfect verb that suits the sense of the sentence and makes it meaningful.

__
 
• **​Accept **carries a sense of **approva**l here. Other words in the options don't carry the sense of approval. So the correct option will be** 'accept'. **More examples are

 
 
• I requested my manager **to accept **my resignation as early as possible.
 
• The bank manager is denied** to accept **my cheque book since it was full of mistakes.
 
 

 Hence, the correct sentence is **Please accept my apology for this mistake. **

** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****__​__**The other three options are not appropriate as those have different meaning and sense of application

 
• **Develop**= **'to evolve'** , '**to advance', **'**to progress'.** The meaning of this word has no relevance to the sentence here. 

 
 
• Like - Entrepreneurs **develop **their skills through trial and error.
 
 
 
• **Acquire**= '**to bring in'**, '**to secure'**. The meaning of this word has no relevance to the sentence here. 
 
 
• Like - The purpose of life is to** acquire** constant knowledge. 
 
 
 
• **Obtain= 'to attain**', '**to get'. **The meaning of this word has no relevance to the sentence here. 
 
 
• Like - This is my golden opportunity of my life to **obtain **advanced degrees.
